record.question: Match the following: Operation - A. Nandankanan Zoological Park B. Nehru Zoological Park C. Sakkarbaug Zoological Park D. Jijamata Udyan with Place - 1. Junagadh 2. Mumbai 3. Bhubaneshwar 4. Hyderabad
record.explanation: Answer A: 3 4 1 2. Pair each zoo with its city: Nandankanan—Bhubaneswar (3); Nehru—Hyderabad (4); Sakkarbaug—Junagadh (1); Jijamata—Mumbai (2). The resulting code 3-4-1-2 is option (a). Reference: https://www.nandankanan.org/; https://www.nehruzoopark.org/; https://junagadhmunicipal.org/; https://byculla-zoo.com/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
